array_floor_writer.name: The floor is being written
array_floor_writer.description: A copy agent consumes and copies the containing hall’s actual structure cells. Writes occur once per operation, with a pause; entrance controls pause and restore changes. The thresholds and perimeter remain. Restoring waits for a body to leave a cell.
array_floor_writer.qfep_connection: An address becomes support for a body. Autonomous writes alter that support while the pickup arrays keep their separate records.
interactions: Observe the sphere consuming or copying a floor cell
Walk around a vacancy or a new obstruction
Use PAUSE / RESUME and RESTORE FLOOR at the entrance
